name: hud
description: claude-hud 0.10.0 as a mod: model, project, git, context, usage, tools, agents and todos, plus alerts, budget, history, a task summary, a detail pane and switchable themes

visible.title: Show the HUD
visible.description: Draw the HUD; /hud, /hud off and /hud on change this too

footerButton.title: Footer button
footerButton.description: A HUD button in the prompt footer that hides and shows the HUD, as /hud off and /hud on do

position.title: Position
position.description: Where the HUD draws: above the prompt (a band) or below it (beside the hint line, where the statusline sat)

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: The HUD's look: palette, icons and separators (neon, rainbow, emoji, sakura, kawaii, mecha, shonen, tokyo-night, matrix; nerd and powerline need a Nerd Font). /hud theme switches it live

showMascot.title: Theme mascot
showMascot.description: Show the anime themes' kaomoji mascot (sakura, kawaii, mecha, shonen), whose face follows the context and quota

extraCmd.title: Extra command
extraCmd.description: claude-hud's --extra-cmd: a shell command whose output becomes a label (needs CLAUDE_HUD_ALLOW_EXTRA_CMD=1)

debug.title: Debug tool
debug.description: Register mcp__hud__hud_debug, which reports the stdin the mod built, the rendered lines and the last error

notifyAfterSeconds.title: Notify after (s)
notifyAfterSeconds.description: Toast (and chime) when a turn that ran at least this long ends; 0 (the default) turns it off

notifySound.title: Notify with a chime
notifySound.description: Play a short chime with the turn-done toast (macOS)

contextAlerts.title: Context alerts (%)
contextAlerts.description: Toast when context use reaches each of these percents, comma separated (e.g. 80,90); empty (the default) turns it off

usageAlerts.title: Usage alerts (%)
usageAlerts.description: Toast when the 5-hour or 7-day limit reaches each of these percents (e.g. 80,90); empty (the default) turns it off

showForecast.title: Usage forecast
showForecast.description: Show when a usage limit runs out at the current rate, if that is before it resets

dailyBudgetUsd.title: Daily budget (USD)
dailyBudgetUsd.description: Show today's spend across sessions against this budget; 0 turns it off

showHistory.title: Spend history
showHistory.description: Show the last 7 days' spend as a sparkline, with the streak of days in use (off by default; /hud detail shows the spend either way)

summaryEveryTurns.title: Task summary every N turns
summaryEveryTurns.description: Summarize the task in one line after the first turn and every N turns (a fork of the conversation, served from the prompt cache); 0 turns it off

compactWarnPercent.title: Auto-compact countdown
compactWarnPercent.description: Show the tokens left before auto-compaction once the context is this percent of the way there; 0 turns it off

coldCacheTokens.title: Expired cache warning
coldCacheTokens.description: Once the prompt cache has expired, show how many tokens the next message writes to it again, when the context holds at least this many; 0 turns it off

turnGrowthTokens.title: Context growth per turn
turnGrowthTokens.description: When a turn grows the context by at least this many tokens, show by how much, beside the recent turns' growth; 0 turns it off

gitDirtyWarn.title: Uncommitted changes warning
gitDirtyWarn.description: Warn when this many paths are changed and uncommitted; 0 turns it off

gitAheadWarn.title: Unpushed commits warning
gitAheadWarn.description: Warn when this many commits are not pushed; 0 turns it off

showAgents.title: Subagent lines
showAgents.description: Show claude-hud's subagent lines; off by default, as Claude Code lists running subagents itself with their time and tokens
